thread:
nina: Heads-up — sample-app Ruby integration started failing when we switched to the official Ruby SDK. REST streaming emits function_call chunks, SDK emits a single final function call object. broke our UI that expects incremental tokens.

todd: can you paste the curl vs SDK streams?

nina: curl (streaming):
```bash
curl -s -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-001","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call weather()"}],"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/stream | jq -c .
```
returns chunks like: 
{"type":"token","delta":"WeatherClient("}
{"type":"token","delta":"city: \"SF\""}
{"type":"function_call","name":"get_weather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"SF\"}"}

Ruby SDK stream (example):
```rb
client.chat.stream(...){ |event| puts event }
```
SDK yields a single event: 
{"type":"function_call","name":"get_weather","arguments": "{\"city\":\"SF\"}"}

jen: that breaks progressive rendering. should stream token deltas for function calls too. is this a server difference or SDK handling?

kyle: dug in. server sends tokenized events; the Ruby SDK's stream parser collects contiguous token events and collapses them into a single object for convenience. unfortunately, it collapses function_call tokens into a final object. other SDKs (py/node) preserve incremental tokens. generator template for Ruby had a convenience aggregator enabled.

eva: OMG that's why our UI shows a blank spinner until complete. we rely on function call args streaming so we can start invoking downstream HTTP calls as soon as arg tokens arrive.

todd: propose two fixes: 1) quickpatch to Ruby SDK to emit raw stream events verbatim (no aggregator) when user passes stream: true, 2) long-term add cross-SDK streaming semantics tests.

kyle: agreed. opened INF-3788: "Ruby SDK stream aggregator collapses function_call tokens -> breaks incremental render" assigned to kyle. PR 860 adds a simple toggle: if params[:stream] is true, parser yields raw events in order. adds unit test mirroring curl stream.

devx-bot: INF-3788 status -> in_progress, linked PR 860.

nina: can we cut a patch quickly? this blocks a few early access customers using server-side streaming with Ruby.

kyle: cutting 0.6.2-patch with the streaming fix and a small sample in the README showing curl vs SDK stream handling. ETA ~25m.

eva: also add a note in the chat streaming doc: "SDKs should not aggregate function_call token events; use raw stream to preserve incremental function args."

kyle: done. released 0.6.2-patch. sample-app pinned and streaming UI is back to incremental. closing INF-3788 after smoke tests.

nina: verified staging and production. thanks for the fast turnaround! :rocket:
